mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_ip_failures (ip_key, username, expires_at) VALUES (#{ipKey}, #{username}, now() + interval '15 minutes') ON CONFLICT (ip_key, username) DO UPDATE SET expires_at = now() + interval '15 minutes'

MERGE INTO login_ip_failures t USING (SELECT #{ipKey} AS ip_key, #{username} AS username FROM DUAL) s ON (t.ip_key = s.ip_key AND t.username = s.username) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.expires_at = + INTERVAL '15' MINUTE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ip_key, username, expires_at) VALUES (s.ip_key, s.username, + INTERVAL '15' MINUTE)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM login_ip_failures WHERE ip_key = #{ipKey} AND expires_at >
